aspirations.summary: Prove you belong at Verdant Gate after the anomaly.
aspirations.fantasy: The hall no longer treats you as an unexplained failure—but belonging is earned, not granted. Make yourself known to the instructors who shape outer disciples, learn the mantra that steadies a foundation, and let Elder Yun Mei record the path you chose.
possible_paths: Speak with Elder Yun Mei in the Foundation Hall about the path you chose.
Travel to the Cultivation Hall and greet Instructor Pei until he trusts you.
When Pei is ready, Request Instruction to learn the Foundation Guard Mantra.

facets.label: Known to Instructor Pei
facets.description: The Cultivation Hall must recognize you as a disciple worth teaching—not a rumor from the Foundation Hall.
facets.hint: Open Travel, go to the Cultivation Hall, and greet Instructor Pei.

facets.label: Foundation Guard Mantra
facets.description: Outer disciples are expected to hold a stabilizing art. Pei teaches it only after a first greeting is not enough—earn a little more trust, then ask.
facets.hint: Greet Pei again (or seek guidance) until Request Instruction appears, then take the lesson.

facets.label: Elder Yun Mei's acknowledgment
facets.description: Yun Mei alone witnessed your permanent choice. Until she records it, the sect's memory of you remains unfinished.
facets.hint: In the Foundation Hall, choose Speak of Your Path with Elder Yun Mei.

aspirations.summary: Win Elder Yun Mei's formal word—the key that opens the Inner Disciple Trial.
aspirations.fantasy: A recommendation is not a stamp. It is an elder risking their name on your readiness. Cultivate favor, standing, and presence until Yun Mei will speak for you.
possible_paths: Assist with an outer duty (herb path, lecture, or grounds chore).
Seek guidance from Elder Yun Mei in the Foundation Hall.
Sort herbs for the herb steward if you need coin or standing.
Improve your foundation through cultivation between duties.

facets.label: Verdant Gate standing
facets.description: The sect ledger must show more than probationary notice.
facets.hint: Outer duties and elder guidance raise Verdant Gate standing.

facets.label: Elder Yun Mei's trust
facets.description: She will not recommend a stranger she corrected once and forgot.
facets.hint: Return to the Foundation Hall. Greet her. Seek counsel. Let trust accumulate.

facets.label: Formal recommendation granted
facets.description: When she is ready, ask for her recommendation—and accept the weight of it.
facets.hint: When Request Recommendation appears under Elder Yun Mei, take it.
